PDF / Drucken Teilen Veröffentlichungsdatum: Vor 30+ Tagen veröffentlicht Stellenbeschreibung A Snapshot of Your Day Join us in revolutionizing the future of materials development! Imagine leading the charge in establishing self-driven laboratories that autonomously design, synthesize, test, and evaluate advanced materials. You will integrate AI-based material design with automated experimentation, creating a seamless workflow that accelerates innovation cycles. By leveraging closed-loop learning, you will continuously enhance digital material models for industrial energy applications, making a significant impact on our mission to drive sustainable energy solutions. How You’ll Make an Impact * Definition and deployment of self-driven lab architectures for streamlined materials development * Integration of AI-based material design with automated synthesis and testing for enhanced efficiency * Design of robotic and parallel experimentation workflows for rapid material innovation * Establishment of closed-loop optimization between machine learning models and lab execution for continuous improvement * Management of large volumes of experimental and sensor data ensuring FAIRness and traceability * Continuous improvement of machine learning models through experimental feedback and bridging of digital predictions with physical validation and scale-up to ensure real-world impact What You Bring * Completed PhD or Master’s degree in Materials Science, Engineering, Physics, or a related discipline * Extensive hands-on experience in R&D or engineering environments * Deep expertise in materials synthesis, characterization, and advanced testing techniques * Demonstrated experience with automation, robotics, and high-throughput experimentation * Strong foundation in AI/ML and data-driven approaches to optimization and process improvement * Extensive experience in closed-loop or self-driven lab environments, coupled with strong leadership and communication skills across technical and business domains About the Team In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
